content: If development error detection for the Watchdog Manager module is enabled, then the function WdgM_GetFirstExpiredSEID() shall check whether the parameter SEID is a NULL pointer (NULL_PTR). If Status is a NULL pointer, then the function shall raise the development error WDGM_E_INV_POINTER (i.e. invalid pointer) and return.
